root_idea.summary: An upright attentiveness directed toward something: standing watch, observing, guarding, or awaiting what is expected.
root_idea.development: The root develops from attentive watching and waiting into meanings for a watcher or guardian, a lookout, and related terms for the neck or elevated observation. Several conventional and figurative usages arise from the idea of watching for an event or maintaining regard for something.

senses.definition: To look for, watch for, await, or expect someone or something.
senses.usage_conditions: The object may be a person, thing, event, or anticipated statement; the Quranic form is imperfect and active.

senses.definition: To regard, observe, or honor an inviolable tie, due, or obligation.
senses.usage_conditions: Used with a covenantal, social, or protected right; this construction explains translations such as respecting or observing a bond.

senses.definition: To remain watchful and alert while anticipating what may occur.
senses.usage_conditions: The Form V reflexive/intensive sense can include guarding oneself or staying on guard in expectation of danger or an approaching event.

senses.definition: To watch for, await, or keep watch for an expected event or person.
senses.usage_conditions: The Quranic occurrences are imperatives directing someone to maintain watch or await the outcome.

senses.definition: One who remains watchful or awaits what is expected.
senses.usage_conditions: Active participle of اِرْتَقَبَ; the Quranic plural refers to people who are also watching or waiting.

senses.definition: The neck, especially the upper or rear base of the neck.
senses.usage_conditions: This is the anatomical sense; in some Quranic constructions the same word is used metonymically for a person or slave.

senses.definition: A slave or captive, expressed metonymically as a “neck.”
senses.usage_conditions: The Quranic usage occurs especially in emancipation, compensation, and alms contexts, including slaves under an emancipation contract.

senses.definition: A watcher, observer, guard, or guardian.
senses.usage_conditions: The Quranic noun can describe an observing human or a divine guardian from whom nothing is hidden; these are contextual applications of the same watching-and-guarding sense.

other_classical_meanings.definition: To guard, keep, preserve, take care of, or remain mindful of a thing.
other_classical_meanings.usage_conditions: A transitive Classical use distinct from merely awaiting or observing.

other_classical_meanings.definition: To fear someone or fear a punishment; hence, to guard oneself or remain wary.
other_classical_meanings.usage_conditions: This is an extended use explained through expecting the punishment of the feared person or power.

other_classical_meanings.definition: To watch a star or asterism while awaiting its setting or a desired time of departure.
other_classical_meanings.usage_conditions: A figurative or specialized application to celestial observation and eager waiting.

other_classical_meanings.definition: To put a rope upon someone’s neck.
other_classical_meanings.usage_conditions: A concrete transitive use with رَقَبَة as the object or body part involved.

other_classical_meanings.definition: To be or become thick in the neck.
other_classical_meanings.usage_conditions: This is a verbal bodily description, distinct from the noun for thickness and the adjective for a thick neck.

other_classical_meanings.definition: To make a pit or trap for catching a leopard.
other_classical_meanings.usage_conditions: A Form II specialized usage connected with the noun رُقْبَة in its trap sense.

other_classical_meanings.definition: A pit or trap made to catch a leopard.
other_classical_meanings.usage_conditions: The trap is described as the equivalent, for a leopard, of a lion-trap or pit.

other_classical_meanings.definition: To assign a house, land, or similar property to someone for use, with its later disposition conditioned by survival or succession.
other_classical_meanings.usage_conditions: The grant may provide that the property belongs to whichever of the two parties survives, or passes to the grantor’s heirs or the recipient’s successors according to the stated arrangement.

other_classical_meanings.definition: Thickness of the neck.
other_classical_meanings.usage_conditions: A nominal bodily description.

other_classical_meanings.definition: Distant relations or ancestors, especially in expressions about inheriting property or distinction from them.
other_classical_meanings.usage_conditions: A figurative plural usage referring to remoter rather than immediate lineage.

other_classical_meanings.definition: A whole human person or self, by synecdoche from the neck.
other_classical_meanings.usage_conditions: Used in expressions placing a sin, obligation, or possession upon someone personally.

other_classical_meanings.definition: A nickname for the Persians or foreigners generally.
other_classical_meanings.usage_conditions: A figurative expression explained by reference to the color or thickness of their necks.

other_classical_meanings.definition: A conditional lifetime gift of a house, land, or similar property, whose final disposition depends on which party dies first.
other_classical_meanings.usage_conditions: The term is associated with mutual watching for the other party’s death; Classical legal authorities differed over its legal classification and effect.

other_classical_meanings.definition: A person whose children do not survive, or who has suffered the loss of children.
other_classical_meanings.usage_conditions: The term is explained through watching anxiously over children and their survival; it is applied to both women and men in the cited lexical evidence.

other_classical_meanings.definition: A woman who awaits the death of her husband in order to inherit his property.
other_classical_meanings.usage_conditions: A specialized conventional use focused on expected inheritance.

other_classical_meanings.definition: An old or poor person unable to earn and waiting for a benefaction or gratuity.
other_classical_meanings.usage_conditions: A figurative use based on awaiting support.

other_classical_meanings.definition: A she-camel that waits for other camels to finish drinking before approaching the water.
other_classical_meanings.usage_conditions: A specialized animal term for waiting until the crowd at the watering place has dispersed.

other_classical_meanings.definition: Calamity or misfortune.
other_classical_meanings.usage_conditions: An idiomatic expression.

other_classical_meanings.definition: The person entrusted with supervising the arrow-shuffler or players in the game of maysir.
other_classical_meanings.usage_conditions: A specialized gaming term for a supervisor or trusted official.

other_classical_meanings.definition: The third gaming arrow in maysir, the one allotted three notches and three portions.
other_classical_meanings.usage_conditions: A technical term of the pre-Islamic game of arrows.

other_classical_meanings.definition: A star or asterism that watches or accompanies another, especially one that rises as the other sets.
other_classical_meanings.usage_conditions: Used for corresponding stars or lunar mansions, including traditional identifications among named stars.

other_classical_meanings.definition: A successor from a person’s offspring or near kin.
other_classical_meanings.usage_conditions: A figurative extension from one who follows or watches after an earlier person.

other_classical_meanings.definition: The son of a paternal uncle.
other_classical_meanings.usage_conditions: A specialized kinship usage, explained in relation to rivalry or mutual watching.

other_classical_meanings.definition: A species of malignant serpent.
other_classical_meanings.usage_conditions: A figurative designation explained as though the serpent watched out of hostility.

other_classical_meanings.definition: A low-status servant or slave who guards a people’s equipment and baggage while they are absent.
other_classical_meanings.usage_conditions: A specialized occupational designation; the source explicitly includes the social-status nuance.

other_classical_meanings.definition: Thick-necked or large-necked; also an epithet for a lion.
other_classical_meanings.usage_conditions: The feminine form is attested for a female slave and is not applied to a free woman in the cited usage.

other_classical_meanings.definition: An elevated place from which a watcher or spy observes at a distance.
other_classical_meanings.usage_conditions: It may be a hill, elevated ground, mountain-top, fortress-top, or comparable lookout.

other_classical_meanings.definition: A skin or hide stripped from the part next to the head and neck.
other_classical_meanings.usage_conditions: A specialized term for the manner or portion from which the hide is removed.

cautions: The Quranic noun رَقَبَة alternates between the anatomical sense “neck” and the metonymic sense “slave or captive”; construction and context determine which is intended.
Form I رَقَبَ may be rendered as watching or awaiting, or as regarding a tie or obligation, depending on its object and construction.
